name: Earthbender Ascension — "if this enchantment has four or more quest counters" reads the enchantment's counters
notes: Fixed with _counterHolder (cards-parser.js): the counter condition was checked against the creature the fired trigger reaches, which has no quest counters, so 'It gains trample' never applied. A (4 quest counters) gives Grizzly Bears trample; B (3) gives Runeclaw Bear nothing. The trigger's picker lists only your creatures. Memory: project_counter_condition_on_the_source_2026-10-15.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Runeclaw Bear
scryfallData.flavor_text: The magic of the elves leaves its mark on the forest. The magic of the forest leaves its mark on the animals who live there. The animals of the forest leave their mark on all who trespass.

scryfallData.name: Earthbender Ascension
scryfallData.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters, earthbend 2. Then search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a quest counter on this enchantment. When you do, if it has four or more quest counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains trample until end of turn.
